newsitem.title: GERMANY: Vereinsbank sets Bertrandt shares at 39 DM.
newsitem.headline: Vereinsbank sets Bertrandt shares at 39 DM.

text.p: Germany's Bayerische Vereinsbank said on Monday that it was setting the issue price for shares in auto-engineering company Bertrandt in a capital increase at 39 marks.
The price was set at the top end of the range in a bookbuilding process after the share issue was 33 times oversubscribed.
A total of 900,000 shares were placed, of which 600,000 were from the capital hike and 300,000 sold by current shareholders. The issue volume totalled 35.1 million marks.

Earnings from the capital increase are intended to pay off the costs of a management buyout and finance further expansion at Bertrandt, which remains 70 percent controlled by the Bichler and Kenkmann families, Guersel Sen and Karin Lentes.
Thirty percent of the shares are in free float, and will be listed on the Frankfurt stock exchange's regulated market.
